projects.title: Game Dev Kit
bullets: Built a reusable C# toolkit of common game systems, maintained across 596 files and 78 commits.
Set up continuous integration checks after a broken build shipped to a teammate undetected for days.

projects.title: Zoo Tycoon
bullets: Built an isometric zoo-building game in C# with custom ShaderLab and HLSL shaders across 4,082 files.
Reproduced an animal-pathing bug that only appeared after specific save-and-reload sequences, then documented the steps.

projects.title: Magic Tiles
bullets: Built a rhythm game in C# and HLSL where tapped tiles must sync with the beat.
Tracked down timing bugs caused by frame-rate drift between different devices during testing.

leadership.title: Bug Bash Organizer
bullets: Organized peer bug-hunting sessions for classmates' game projects, using a shared checklist for reporting steps.
Noticed vague bug reports wasted testing time and required environment, sequence, and expected behavior for each report.
